hook.text: Volume 6 of the Polish Jazz series, it was recorded with the group the saxophonist leads.

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Zbigniew Namysłowski (alto saxophone), Adam Matyszkowicz (piano), Janusz Kozłowski (double bass), Czesław Bartkowski (drums)

sentences.text: Every track is a composition by the bandleader.
Wojciech Piętowski directed the recording, and Halina Jastrzębska was the sound engineer.
The text on the sleeve, a note about the record, is by Józef Balcerak.
The whole record runs for fifty minutes.
